mechanism: Loperamide may mask gastrointestinal symptoms of amikacin-induced toxicity and increase amikacin absorption/retention by reducing intestinal motility, potentially elevating systemic exposure to this nephrotoxic aminoglycoside.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if necessary, monitor renal function closely and maintain adequate hydration; do not use loperamide to manage amikacin-related diarrhea.
